comparison.objective: Remove a named cartridge fuse with an insulated puller and place it in a tray.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool grasp, correct-fuse selection, constrained jaw placement, and rocking extraction from spring clips.
comparison.success_condition: F2 removed while held by puller and placed at rest in tray; disturbing F1/F3 zeros, and unsupported removal caps credit.
comparison.reason: Tests tool-mediated selective extraction from clips, not passive geometry-based separation of a mixed free-body load.
